description: Defines functions and API for managing a vector of data model instances, including initialization, addition, removal, querying, and dumping of instance data.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a vector of data model instances.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Destroys and frees resources associated with the instance vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a new instance to the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_Remove
methods.description: Removes an instance from the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_IsExist
methods.description: Checks if a matching instance exists in the vector.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_DoesFirstLevelInstanceExist
methods.description: Checks if a first-level instance exists under a given node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetNextInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the next instance after a given node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetNumInstances
methods.description: Gets the number of instances under a node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_GetInstances
methods.description: Retrieves all instances under a node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshBaselineInstances
methods.description: Refreshes baseline instances for a parent node.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_DumpTable
methods.description: Dumps the instance table to a specified path.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_RefreshInstance
methods.description: Refreshes a specific instance based on a path.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_NextLockPeriod
methods.description: Advances to the next lock period.

methods.name: DM_INST_VECTOR_SeedInstance
methods.description: Seeds a new instance with expiry time and expected group ID.
